display.purpose: Hero name and closing line only.

motion.name: ease-out-strong

components.name: Primary Email Button
components.description: The one filled action: email. Hero 52px, header 44px.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 28px; background:#123a8c; color:#f7f7f5; font:500 0.9375rem/1.4 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; border-radius:0; transition:background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:#0c2a6b; } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(0.98); }

components.name: Document Link
components.description: Underlined blue link; underline thickens on hover.
components.css: .ds-doc { color:#123a8c; font:0.9375rem/1.4 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:1px; text-underline-offset:0.2em; transition:text-decoration-thickness 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-doc:hover { color:#0c2a6b; text-decoration-thickness:2px; }

components.name: Key Figures
components.description: Signature: hairline table of figures, each with a footnote marker tied to a source note.
components.html:
Ventures founded31
Working languagesES · EN · FR2
  1. 1. ETH Cali, Ekinoxis, Convexo.
  2. 2. Spanish Native, English C1, French B2.
components.css: .ds-fig { font:0.9375rem/1.4 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#0d1117; background:#f7f7f5; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-fig table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; } .ds-fig th, .ds-fig td { border-top:1px solid #c9ccd2; padding:12px 0; } .ds-fig th { text-align:left; font-weight:400; color:#4a5260; } .ds-fig td { text-align:right; font-weight:600; } .ds-fig sup { color:#4a5260; font-size:0.7em; margin-left:4px; } .ds-fig tr:hover { background:rgba(13,17,23,0.03); } .ds-fig tr:hover sup { color:#123a8c; } .ds-fig ol { list-style:none; margin:12px 0 0; padding:12px 0 0; border-top:1px solid #c9ccd2; font-size:0.75rem; color:#4a5260; }

components.name: Margin Section Heading
components.description: DocSection: full width ink rule, serif title in the left 3 of 12 columns.
components.html:
Track record

Content sits in the remaining nine columns.
components.css: .ds-sec { background:#f7f7f5; color:#0d1117; padding:64px 0; } .ds-sec .r { height:1px; background:#0d1117; } .ds-sec .g { display:grid; grid-template-columns:3fr 9fr; gap:40px; padding-top:32px; } .ds-sec h2 { margin:0; font:600 2rem/1.25 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-sec p { margin:0; font:1rem/1.6 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#4a5260; }

components.name: Logo Tile
components.description: Navy band tile, optically sized logo plus domain; 1px raised navy gaps.
components.css: .ds-tile { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; height:144px; width:200px; background:#0b1730; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 200ms; } .ds-tile:hover { background:#13234a; } .ds-tile .l { color:#eef2f8; font:600 1.25rem 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-tile .d { color:#a7b4c9; font:0.75rem/1.4 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-tile:hover .d { color:#eef2f8; }

narrative.overview: The candidate presented like an institutional offering memorandum: summary of terms, tabular proof, sourced claims. Cool paper, near black ink, hairline rules as the only structure, one institutional blue for actions and links, navy reserved for full bleed bands.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, near black ink, one blue, two navy bands
Source Serif 4 display over Public Sans text, tabular figures in data
Hairline rules are the only structure
Rules typeset in once on load; nothing else enters

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Institutional Blue marks only actions and links, the hero title line and the active footnote.

rules.name: The Navy Reserve Rule
rules.body: Navy appears only as full bleed bands.

rules.name: The Tabular Facts Rule
rules.body: Numbers and dates sit in tabular lining figures.

rules.name: The Middot Rule
rules.body: Inline data joins with a spaced middot; ranges use 'to'; no dashes in copy.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift; hover changes colour or underline, not elevation.

rules.name: The Sourced Figure Rule
rules.body: No number on the cover without a footnote naming its source.

dos: Do open each content section with the DocSection margin heading
Do keep blue for actions and links
Do route every logo through optical sizing
Do keep targets 44px and focus visible
donts: Don't use cards, shadows, glow, gradients or rounded corners
Don't use a monospace face or tracked uppercase labels
Don't place eyebrow labels above headings
Don't add a second accent or navy panels on paper
Don't animate beyond the rules typesetting in
Don't use dashes as punctuation in copy
